paite: Amoz tapa Isaiin Judate kumpipa Uzzia te, Jothamte, Ahaz te, Hezekia te lal laia, Judate leh Jerusalem tugtang thu-a kilakna a muh thu.
english: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

paite: Vante aw, ngaikhia unla, lei aw, bil doh in, TOUPAN thu a gen hi: Tapate ka khoia ka khanglian saka, ka tungah lah a hel ngal ua.
english: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.

paite: Bawngtalin a neitu a theia, sabengtungin leng a pu anpiakna a thei: Israelten bel a theikei uh, ka miten a ngaihtuah kei uh, chiin.
english: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know, my people don’t consider.”

paite: Ah! nam gilou thulimlouhna gikpi pua mite, chi thil hoihlou hihte, ta hoihlou pi-a gamta sekte ahi ua: TOUPA a paisan ua, Israelte Mi Siangthou a musit ua, kihihtuamin a nungtolhta uh.
english: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken Yahweh. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.

paite: Bang achia hel sansana, vuaka om lailai na hi ua oi? Lutang a pumin a chi a naa, lungtang leng a pumin a gimta.
english: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

paite: Khepek nuaia kipana lutang phain damlai himhim a om kei; chikeh, vuak sidup ek, meima nai la ngen ahi: huaite lah a mek bing kei ua, tuam leng a tuam sam kei ua, sathau leng a nuh kei uh.
english: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it: wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t been closed, neither bandaged, neither soothed with oil.

paite: Na gam uh loihin a omkhita; na khuate uh meiin a kangkhinta: na gam uh gam dang miten na mitmuh un a neikhin ua, gam dang mite hihsiat bangin a sekhinta.
english: Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

paite: Zion tanu tuh grep huana vennabuk bang leh, tangmai huana buk bang leh, khopi um suak banga nutsiatin a omta.
english: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.

paite: Sepaihte TOUPAN hihmanthat bang tawmchik honna sit sakta lou hileh Sodom bangin i omkhin thamta ding ua, Gamorra bangin i omkhinta ding uhi.
english: Unless Yahweh of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom; we would have been like Gomorrah.

paite: Sodom vaihawmte aw, TOUPA thu ja un; Gomorra mite aw, i Pathian dan thu-ah bil doh un.
english: Hear the word of Yahweh, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” , you people of Gomorrah!

paite: TOUPAN, Huzahzaha na kithoihna uh kei dinga bang ahia a thamatna om? Belamtal haltuma latte leh gan vakthaute thauin a honnimta; bawngpate leh belam noute leh kelpate sisan ah leng ka kipak kei, a chi.
english: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?,” says Yahweh. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.

paite: Ka maa kilan dinga na hongpai un, ka biakin huangsuang intual sik kuan a honphuta?
english: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to trample my courts?

paite: Thilpiak bangmahloute hontawi nawn kei un; banghiam gimlim kei adingin thil kihhuaipi ahi; kha thakte, khawlnite, khawmpite na kichial khawmte mawkmawk uh ka iplah mahmah; thulimlouhna ahi, kikhopna thupitak leng.
english: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me; new moons, Sabbaths, and convocations: I can’t bear with evil assemblies.

paite: Na kha thakte uleh hunbi neia na ankuangluinate uh ka lungsimin a hua hi: kei adin tunggikna ahi; ka thuak chimta hi.
english: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them.

paite: Huchiin na khut uh na jak chiang un leng ka mit kon humsan dia: ahi, tamveipi na thum chiang un leng ka ngaikhe kei ding: na khutte ulah sisanin a dim ngal a.
english: When you spread forth your hands, I will hide my eyes from you. Yes, when you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.

paite: Kisil unla, kihihsiang un; ka mitmuh phaklouh din na thilhihte uh a gitouhna koih mang un; gilou hih tawpta uh:
english: Wash yourselves, make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.

paite: Thil hoih hih kisinta unla; vaihawmna diktat zong un, nuaisiahna thuakte panpih unla, pa neiloute vaihawm sak unla, meithai thu gensak un, a chi hi.
english: Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Judge the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”

paite: TOUPAN, Hongpai un, ngaihtuah khawm dih ve ni! Na khelhnate uh san au bangin aom mahleh, vuk bangin a ngou ding; san dup bangin san khin mahleh belam mul bangin a om ding.
english: “Come now, and let us reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

paite: Gennoptak leh thumanga na om uleh, na gam thil hoihte uh na ne ding uh:
english: If you are willing and obedient, you shall eat the good of the land;

paite: Ahihhangin na ut kei ua na hel uleh, namsau nekkhitin na om ding uh: TOUPA kamin huai thu a genta hi, a chi a.
english: but if you refuse and rebel, you shall be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”

paite: Bangchidan ahia khopi muanhuaitak kijuak a hongsuah maimah, vaihawm diktatnaa dimnu hi sek hi a! amahah diktatna a om seka, tun lah tualthatmite!
english: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice; righteousness lodged in her, but now murderers.

paite: Na dangka eksia a honghita, na uain lah tui toh hel a hita.
english: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.

paite: Na mi liante mihel hat, guta te pawmte ahi uh; mi chihin golhna a deih ua, thilpiak a delh nak uhi: pa neiloute a hawmsak sek kei ua, meithaite makhua khualna leng a kiang uh a tung ngei sam kei hi.
english: Your princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes, and follows after rewards. They don’t judge the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come to them.

paite: Huaijiakin, TOUPA, Sepaihte TOUPA, Israelte Mi Hatin hichiin a chi! A! hondoute tungah ka hehna ka tangtungsak dia, ka melmate tungah phu ka la ding:
english: Therefore the Lord, The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” Yahweh of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: “Ah, I will get relief from my adversaries, and avenge myself of my enemies;

paite: Huan, na tungah ka khut ka kha dinga, na eksia siang sipsipin ka hihmang ding, na sikgawm tengteng ka la mang vek ding:
english: and I will turn my hand on you, thoroughly purge away your dross, and will take away all your tin.

paite: Huan, na sung vaihawmtute a tunga a om bang un ka omsak nawn dinga, na sunga lemtheimite a masapena a om bang un ka omsak lai ding hi: Huai khitchiangin, Diktatna khopi, khopi muanhuai, a honchi ding uhi.
english: I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called ‘The city of righteousness, a faithful town.’

paite: Zion tun vaihawmna diktata hotkhiak a hita dinga, a sunga mi piangthak nawnte leng diktatnaa hotkhiak ahi ding uhi.
english: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.

paite: Ahihhangin mihelte leh mikhialte hihsiatna a kituakin a om dinga, TOUPA paisanmite leng hihanin a om ding uh.
english: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake Yahweh shall be consumed.

paite: Na tosaw deihmahmahte uh a zumpihta ding ua, na huan telte ujiakin zakta takin na om sin uhi.
english: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.

paite: Tosaw a nah kaite leh huan tui mu lou bang phet lah na hi sin ngal ua, Huan, mi hat tak zija jial bang a hita dinga, a nasep meiek bang ahi ding; huchiin a kang tuaktuak ding ua, kuamahin a phelh kei ding uh, chiin.Huan, mi hat tak zija jial bang a hita dinga, a nasep meiek bang ahi ding; huchiin a kang tuaktuak ding ua; kuamahin a phelh kei ding uh, chiin.
english: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water.

paite: Huan, mi hat tak zija jial bang a hita dinga, a nasep meiek bang ahi ding; huchiin a kang tuaktuak ding ua; kuamahin a phelh kei ding uh, chiin.
english: The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them.”
